faqs.question: What services does Unique Web Layer offer?
faqs.answer: We offer 11 types of websites: Business/Company, E-Commerce, Landing Page, Portfolio, Blog, Booking System, LMS, Real Estate, Restaurant, SaaS Web App, and Membership websites.

faqs.question: How much does a website cost?
faqs.answer: Our pricing starts from $199 for Landing Pages, $499 for Business Websites, $999 for E-Commerce, and custom web apps from $1499+. Contact us for a custom quote.

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.answer: Yes! We work with clients worldwide including US, Canada, UK, Australia, and many other countries.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a website?
faqs.answer: Timeline depends on complexity: Landing Pages take 1-2 weeks, Business Websites 2-3 weeks, E-Commerce 4-6 weeks, and complex web apps 6-10 weeks.

faqs.question: Do you provide support after project completion?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide free support for 1-3 months depending on the package. Extended support packages are also available.

faqs.question: What technologies do you use?
faqs.answer: We use React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Python, MongoDB, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, and more based on project requirements.

faqs.question: Can you redesign my existing website?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We specialize in website redesigns that improve user experience and loading speed.

faqs.question: How can I start a project?
faqs.answer: Click the 'Start Project' button on our website, fill out the contact form, or email us directly. We'll schedule a free consultation.

faqs.question: What is your payment structure?
faqs.answer: We typically require 50% advance to start the project and 50% upon completion. For larger projects, we offer milestone-based payments.
